title: Same-Day Waiver Rate for Summit Members and Corporate Travelers
content:
**Benefit terms — same-day changes on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The same-day change fee of a same-day confirmed exchange is multiplied by the **same-day waiver rate**, which follows the Summit membership the ticket credits in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program and the corporate travel agreement the ticket names under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements. The rate acts on the unrounded fee; the fee is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## The rate

| Situation shown by the records | Same-day waiver rate |
|---|---|
| An active Summit membership whose tier waives the same-day change fee, **or** an active corporate agreement named on the ticket whose tier waives change fees | 0 (the fee is waived) |
| An active Summit membership whose tier includes complimentary preferred seating but does not waive the same-day change fee, on a ticket naming no active agreement whose tier waives change fees, whose holder has at least **6** Summit flight accruals dated within the last 12 months | **0.65** |
| Any other passenger | 1 (the fee is unchanged) |

## Where the facts are read

- Membership status and tier: the Summit membership record the ticket credits, and the tier's benefits (same-day change fee waiver, complimentary preferred seating) in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program terms.
- Flight accruals: the member's Summit activity history, counting flight accrual entries dated within the last 12 months.
- Agreement: the status of the agreement the ticket names and whether its tier waives change fees, in the Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements records.

## Boundary and combination cases (hypothetical)

| Membership | Tier waives same-day fee | Tier includes preferred seating | Flight accruals, last 12 months | Waiving agreement active | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | Yes | 2 | No | 0 |
| None | — | — | — | Yes | 0 |
| Active | No | Yes | 6 | No | 0.65 |
| Active | No | Yes | 5 | No | 1 |
| Not active | No | Yes | 9 | No | 1 |
| Active | No | No | 12 | No | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A fee of 60 dollars with a same-day waiver rate of 0.65 becomes 39.00 dollars.
